name: mirage
text: Parlay check 21:51 (paper mode, nothing new traded): one more of the real parlays settled and the buyer's parlay hit again, so all 4 settled so far lost (-$11.68); 15 are still open on weekend games. 4 for 4 is only a small sample but it's a warning sign for adverse selection (buyers may be picking parlays where our fair odds are too low). That's one more reason to stay on paper until at least 20 have settled. Paper numbers still look fine (96 of the last 500 priced trades would win).
